scope: Scoped agent review of nine complete current native viewports, including overview, compact regional symbols, detailed restoration and selected formations in published Asia and Shanhaiguan scenarios. Not commercial art approval.
observations: Regional formations appear as separate faction counters, leaving more of the ground, rivers and settlements visible. They are not merged army clusters.
Selected regional formations regain the existing detailed unit source, legal movement preview and ordinary inspector. Close views restore existing unit and settlement art.
The old repeated vector terrain marks are absent while painted mountain and woodland scenery remains visible.
Both complete desktop viewport shapes retain the normal HUD. The 2400x1080 layout is not a physical phone capture.
remaining_visual_issues: Coarse DEM light facets and repeated scenery placement still read as discrete shapes. Terrain-to-scenery and river-bank transitions need further art work.
Close Asian views still become dense when every full building and formation is restored. This patch improves regional symbols, not all near-view composition.
Local administrative/control boundaries remain visually distinct from the physical coastline.
The selected Lin Zexu inspector still uses an unillustrated portrait panel; only the existing roster portraits are available.
Location-specific bridges and ports, all-unit animation cycles, formal historical/art review and physical Motorola X30 acceptance remain outstanding.
